input.brief: EnsoCode is a local-first desktop coding-agent workbench. Design a pinned Extensions screen for skills and MCP connections, borrowing Open Vetta's restrained banner and browsable catalog while keeping the existing EnsoCode ocean-blue shell.
screens: Extensions catalog: installed and curated views, search, source and readiness, clickable item details

stated.mood: 参考 Open Vetta「能力」页：轻量横幅、低边界图标条目、紧凑的目录工具栏；保留 EnsoCode 的工作台外壳。
stated.emphasis: 「扩展」放在主侧边栏，位于项目列表上方；先看设计稿。

obvious: A generic extension store with a giant promotional header and bordered marketplace cards under the main navigation.

proposals.name: 薄荷白扩展目录
proposals.idea: On this screen, EnsoCode's in-conversation /skill commands and its project-local SKILL.md imports become physical objects paired with the desktop's MCP connections.
proposals.departs: A small tactile banner like Open Vetta's Ability page, then flat grouped rows and one compact catalog toolbar, inside the current app shell.
proposals.layout: Keep the live rail, project sidebar, title and status bar; put the Extensions item just above the project list and use the entire content pane for the catalog. A drawer gives detail without losing the list.

devices.reason: A tight physical edge under the three small objects in the reference-inspired banner, and a lifted detail drawer.
Only the mint banner has subtle dotted drafting-paper texture, supporting the code cards instead of decorating the whole UI.
Show real slash-command syntax and SKILL.md as code in the two small banner objects.

proposals.name: 连接工作台
proposals.idea: On this screen, EnsoCode's current-session versus new-session extension loading becomes a two-sided view of installed settings and actual usage requirements.
proposals.departs: Instead of browse-first cards, a tight ledger sits next to a permanently visible inspector for source, permissions and when changes take effect.
proposals.layout: Main sidebar selects Extensions; a split content well pairs a searchable two-column ledger with a persistent detail inspector.

proposals.name: 对话命令页
proposals.idea: On this screen, EnsoCode's project-local design and CDP skills become a compact command sheet you can read while starting a task.
proposals.departs: Uses command signatures and documentation snippets, not store tiles or a promotional banner; highlights the action for getting an extension into a chat.
proposals.layout: Keep the left sidebar, pair a wide command list with a narrow conversational usage column, with an inline selected-row expansion.
